Now that I've read the previous, I am glad I started HERE, (Rachel) - because this (to me) is a new author, unknown to me, ... and Saving Rachel on it's own showed great premise, terrific plot, page turning interest, and the best part is that after I've read this VERY UNIQUE book, I'm now hooked on Donovan Creed, and John Locke. The plot is very strange, unique, fast and furious.  I did not put it down until the end, and I quickly saw what this author is about.  Good Reads.  If you like mystery, detective, you will LOVE this book, and this author.  I've now purchased the 2-3 previous books, and am so enjoying that I know I will purchase all the rest.  I hope Mr. Locke can turn out more as good as all the 6 I have so far, it's just too much fun.  Superb stories, rather unique, but still with a mystery/detective keynote that makes them rather one of a kind in the genre.

I am becoming addicted to this writer! His stories are full of excitement, new ideas, and just good imagination. "Saving Rachel" had me up at night just reading to see what would happen next. I think I have fallen in love with the clever Donovan Creed! I can't wait to start the next one. Carole McKee Writer

Whenever I buy a book for 99 cents I think " what can I lose?"  In this case.....I WON!  For me there's nothing more frustrating than figuring out what's going to happen next.  There was no way I could do that with this book.  Just when I thought things were over a new twist was taken.....and I really couldn't put the book (or rather my iPad) down.  Don't miss this one!
This book was very very good. The story is a bit complex but it does get resolved at the end and explains everything to a T. I read it in 2 days. Recommended for ages 14 and up.

I've read a number of Ken Follet's other books, but A Dangerous Fortune is one of his best! Full of intrigue, twists and turns, it's so difficult to put the book down. Follet has masterfully developed a very intricate and complex story, that keeps you wondering what's going to happen next. A definite must!

This is a FANTASTIC book!  Wasn't sure about it in the beginning but it keeps you on your toes.  This is the first time I have read something where I couldn't predict the next part of the story.  ENJOY!!

i found this on kindle while getting over a few days in bed with bronchitis here in italy. loved it but had to takea break often because my laughing out loud hurt a lot. not complaing about the price i paid $3.99 as it was well worth it but why do many of the other reviewers say they got it for 99 cents on kindle ? could be quite a saving as i now want to read all the books in the series all now priced at $3.90 ???

Saving Rachel is one of those books that I couldn't stop reading because I wanted to know how it was going to end. John Locke is an amazing and talent author. This book consists of so much twists and turns which had me on my heels. The main character of this book is on mission to save his wife because she was kidnapped. From the get-go I was intrigued and didn't want to stop reading. Definitely a must read!

When I first saw this book I said " Great, another predictable horror book".... Boy was I wrong! I was swept off my feet by this chilling novel, with a new plot change every page turn, this book will be sure to keep you sucked in... I'm sure it did for me! I was surprised that it was only the price it is for the stunning material I discovered inside. All in all, a great book, and I highly suggest it to all readers who like to sit on the edge of there chairs!

You have to read this series in order to uunderstand just how fantastic Saving Rachel is!  I admit I almost deleted book one early on but stayed with it for the heck of it. I am hooked on the Donovon Creed Series, it is absolutely worth it.

This is the first book in the series that I read, I loved it so much that I downloaded and read the first book, Lethal People the next day. Action thrillers on steroids! I bought the rest of the books in the series. It's hard to put down once you start reading. I am thrilled to have seen this book on the kindle book page, or I never would have known about this awesome author and this new series! You rock dude.......

FIVE STARS! This book is written in an easy to read style and is an excellent choice for a vacation read. This story will keep you on your toes form the start till the end, it has a very interesting plot which is a must read for mystery lovers. I am very satisfied with this purchase and I am a huge fan of the author.

I ordered this to see what all the buzz was about. This was ranked #1 when i purchased it, so i figured it had to be something special. It was. This was a very fast paced, suspenseful novel that kept me reading to find out what was going to happen next. Sam was a funny character and I liked the way the story changed perspectives towards the end. There was alot going on here and the plot twists were well thought out. I look forward to ordering another Donovan Creed novel and I thank Mr. Locke for writing an entertaining novel.

John Locke has done it again with Saving Rachel.  Would suggest first timers start with the first three books in the series or the story will seem quite far fetched without knowing more about the character backgrounds.

This book was a thriller and I couldn't put it down. This is the type of book it doesn't matter what genre you like you will love this book no matter what. It is so suspenseful and I promise you, you will finish this book in a day or two because you won't be able to put it down without knowing what's happens next!

I discovered the Creed series about a week ago, and have finished all five.  Entertaining light reading at its best.  With each book, Creed's character is better developed, and by design Creed's character is evolving.  I've recommended the series to every Kindle reader I know! It is refreshing to find an author and publisher who are not out to milk Kindle readers and as his books continue to move up the Kindle Best Seller list, hopefully others will take note.

Locke outdid himself with this one! Not only were the characters and the story itself all fantastic, but the way the author split the novel into the perspectives of our two main characters - Same Case and, of course, Donovan Creed - was brilliant. This novel, unlike some of Locke's others, focused solely on the one task at hand for our hero - as the title suggests, he must save Rachel. But the twists and turns that the reader encounters, the switches and change-ups, the surprises, the betrayals, and everything else in between leaves me wanting more and more! Outstanding is hardly enough to describe this novel.

I'm actually laughing at some of the negative reviews about the plot being unbelievable. Do you guys even know what the word "fiction" means?! I was heading on vacation and wanted something entertaining; Saving Rachel was exactly that. I read most of the story while swinging in a hammock on the beach and I couldn't turn the pages on my Kindle fast enough. I loved the twists and turns, some which I guessed, some which I did not. Now I'm going through all of John Locke's novels to see which will be my next purchase. The fact that I pay $0.99 for each of them makes it even better. Considering I can't even buy a pack of gum for $0.99, the fact that I can buy and get more enjoyment out of John Locke's novels let's me know I'm getting a great deal.

Wow! This novel is an emotional rollercoaster full of twists and turns. Its like I have just been pulled under murky water and have no idea which way is up until the very last moment. My mind is still reeling! This book is unique in that it goes through the entire events of the day from Sam's prospective, but then we start back at the beginning in Donovan Creed's (one of Sam's clients) prospective. You certainly gain different information from each and the two mingle together to make sense of the madness. I don't want to give anything away, since most of the magic is in the mystery. All I will say is, amazing. Certainly a must read if you are a lover of mystery, murder mystery, or just pure chaos! I rate this book as adult because of both language and sexual content. I wouldn't reccommend this for teenagers. It isn't appropriate

By far my favorite book by this author! It is such a fast read, I actually read it in one siting. I loved the narrative although I found the breaking of the "fourth wall" distracting at times. I found the character of Sam Case particularly charming in a womanizing way. With the plot twisting and turning on every page, this book will not give you one dull moment.

An excellent storyline, has the readers fully involved from the first page. This book will surely have you ignoring time to get a little more pages done in your read. I had a good time just relaxing and losing myself into the book into the world of donovan creed. A must read.

All I can say is this book is definitely worth the $0.99 I spent on the purchase.  I read Saving Rachel in one day, and there are not many books I can say I have read that fast.  This book definitely has many unexpected twists and will keep you interested!

John Locke is a master storyteller!!  Saving Rachel is his best told mystery to date.  Full of twists and turns, you grow to care about the characters no matter how flawed they are, and you will never guess where the story ends up.  John Locke is quickly becoming my favorite mystery writer!

This was one of the best books I've read in quite awhile. In fact, it was so good I couldn't put it down and I ended up finishing it in one evening. 'Saving Rachael' is a suspenseful story filled with plenty of twists, turns, double crosses, double dealings and intrigue- along with a dash of dark humor for good measure. This is the first Donovan Creed novel I've read and I'm glad that there are two more preceding it. I can't wait to read more about the adventures of the improbable hero of this series!

"Saving Rachel" by John Locke was a most unexpected surprise.  The story begins with a seemingly normal day for a seemingly normal guy but quickly dissolves into his worst nightmare: his wife has been kidnapped and he is in the race of his life to save her.  John Locke has a unique way of drawing his readers in and putting them in the driver's seat of this tightly written story.  This was my first John Locke novel and I look forward to getting my hands on the next one!

As a crime/thriller/mystery fanatic, I will have to say that "Saving Rachel" by John Locke delivered much more than I expected.  This is a fast paced read that drops you into the middle of Sam Case's worst nightmare and keeps you on your toes until the very end.  I was literally breathless by the time this book was over.  John Locke has a way of immersing his readers in the moment, letting them feel every twist, turn, and heart pounding second of this novel.  This is my third John Locke novel and I'm hooked.  I would recommend this book to anyone who enjoys a good adrenaline rush.

Saving Rachael is like riding the fastest, twistiest, roller coaster you can imagine.  In pitch darkness. You don't know where or when the next twist is going to come, and when it does, your stomach drops out.  Want a literary work?  Read Chaucer.  If you want fast action, reckless dialogue, a story that grips you, and an author that doesn't give a crap about traditional writing styles, read Saving Rachel.

First of all, I'm not a rabid reader. I rarely read at all, especially fiction. I bought this book through a nontraditional channel. I bought John Locke's book about how he sold over one million books as a self published author, first. I don't have that specific title handy, however. Search for it, you'll find it. I was actually interested in learning about writing e-books in general, but this book was about writing for e-book readers such as the Kindle and how to market successfully. At the time of buying that book, I actually thought it was about a different but related topic. Anyway, It was related enough that I continued to read. That book inspired me enough to read other books on the topic. However, in the book as any good publisher should do, he mentioned some of his best sellers. Saving Rachel At some point I decided to buy the book Saving Rachel. But, because I became so interested in self publishing from the first book I read, I actually bought the print version out of curiosity of what potential a printed book from a self published author could look like. Literally Fantastic. Professional cover with raised letters and professional imagery. After reading the book, (actually I have two chapters left) I noticed that even the picture on the cover was not random at all. Very significant to the storyline. Storyline I won't give everything away. However, what I noticed is that John Locke is a genius. By that I mean, If he can keep my attention, he's ON! I'm an English teacher as a foreign language in Japan. In between lessons I'm running to grab the book while peering at the clock from time to time hoping I can get another page in. The suspense should be illegal. He has so many twists and turns that I think John Locke was inspired by the movie or book "The Game." John Locke made a statement in the first book I read about writing books that he is not among the great authors, but that his writing doesn't suck. I have verified both points. He might not be Shakespeare, but, he will keep your attention! If you like fiction, I highly recommend this book.

Haven't we all been afraid of someone hiding in our house while we were there? How about having Donovan Creed living in your attic for two years and watching everything you did on video monitors and relaxing in your house all day while you and your wife were at work? That is just the beginning. Sex and murders, and things not at all as they seem. If you are looking for Leo Tolstoy you should not be reading John Locke. If you are looking for an interesting, fast paced, escape read as entertainment, Saving Rachel is right on target.
I loved this book.  The plot was so fast I could hardly keep up.  And I loved Donovan Creed.  He is one of my all time favorite leading men...so wicked!

This was the firzt of John Locke's books I had read. I stumbled upon it by accident one late night after finishing a book. At such a low Nook price, I could not resist it and thought I would give it a go. I am SO glad I did. Like many of the other reviewers, I could not put this book down. If only I did not have to work, I too would have finished it in a day! I was biting my nails one minute and laughing so hard the tears were coming the next. Such a roller coaster of emotions! I just never knew what would happen when I turned the next page, and I was always in awe of the originality of what the next page held. A great read, a quick read, humor, romance (yes, romance), guns, gangsters and cheating spouses. What's not to love???
This has been another great Donovan Creed story I really got into this one and had trouble putting it down, anyone who has read one of John Locke books should read this one.

A truly fun read - fast paced and flowing. Augusta is so deliciously evil,it's a wonder no one kicked her butt down the stairs as well they should have. Some characters are the ones you love to hate and others are just plain good guys that get the short end of the stick.  My only complaint is that I needn't be told again of something that happened only a hundred pages back - this much I can still remember! Apart from that, this is a super book with well developed characters and recommended to all who secretly adore a great "penny dreadful".

For me, this review is perfectly put into perspective with just one word... "Wow"!!!!!!!! What I loved about this particular Donovan Creed book were the plot devices Locke used. Nothing can describe these twisted plot elements other than "wow"...okay... and maybe... "how superfab weird and wonderfully intriguing is that"?!!!! Well done, John!  You rocked it again!!!

This is a very intriguing, lively page-turner. Or, we say in Texas, a barn-burner! I read most of it at one sitting, not wanting to put it down, finished the next morning. I love John Locke's writing style: sassy, irreverent and totally captivating! Can't wait to read the other books!

This is an amazingly fast thriller, one of Locke's best.  It is very suspenseful, keeps you guessing throughout, and is extremely funny at points.  You will absolutely not want to put this one down, and it's an exceptional value at $0.99. Strongly recommended.

Yes, it was unbelievable, but lots of fun to read!  I am not a professional reviewer, but I found it to be very well written.  Somewhat quirky.  To those who said it was too unbelievable --- so is Science Fiction, and most Romance Novels. There were lots of twists and turns.  I don't know how the Author kept tract of all of it.  I found a couple of pages in the middle to be a little confusing, but not enough to deter me from reading to the end to see what was going to happen. Give this book a chance -- I think you will like it unless you prefer to read true stories.

This book is great! I have now read four john Locke books and he never fails to keep the reader involved in his story. He wrote this book with two first person viewpoints; one in the personage of Sam Case and the other in the personage of his'main character, Donovan Creed. I am envious. . . Here I am trying to figure out how to write one character in the first person and John Locke does two in the same book with apparent ease. Sam Case is in trouble. He has devised a scheme whereby he hides money by shipping it all over the world  24 hours every day. At last count, he was managing over nine billion dollars and the people who entrusted the money with him are killers and master criminals who would not take kindly to losing their money. After a set of bizarre circumstances, Sam finds himsel not only on the verge of losing all the money but also having to choose who will live and die  between his wife and his new mistresss. Who would you choose and would you give away the codes which released the money? Will Donovan Creed help? Read the book and find out. Great read. I highly recommend this book.
FIVE STARS! A PAGE TURNER... With twists and turns a plenty. And a smacking ending to it all. If you really want to be thrilled: go buy it now... you'll thank me later!
Again, Ken Follett does not disappoint. I am a big fan of his work. If you are looking for a fast paced, exciting book - this is for you. I could not put it down!

Saving Rachel is a fun and thrilling mystery about Sam Case, a computer programmer turned millionaire.  Sam is cheating on his wife and helping criminals hide billions of dollars through his software creation.  He finds himself in more trouble than he can handle when he must finally choose who will die - his wife for his mistress.  Will Sam be able to get out of the trouble he is in, or will he get what is coming to him? The second part of the book introduces Donovan Creed's point of view.  Creed is a hired assassin that opens this whole story up to readers and wraps it up in a nice package.  I really enjoyed this book and look forward to reading more Donovan Creed adventures!

If you are longing for something interesting, this is it. You might even need a second vacation to recover from the excitement. Having never read John Locke before, I was very pleasantly surprised to find a book that held my attention.  The plot twists and turns in the most random and unexpected ways.  Just when you think you know what's going on, your your chess-like theory about what the author is plotting is bucked by unanticipated circumstances leaving you wondering what just happened. Very imaginative and full of quick-paced action, this novella never leaves a moment to become bored. It is charged with thrills in every direction. I couldn't put it down. Just one more paragraph, one more page, one more chapter! Putting this book down is like asking a 3 year old to give you back the candy he just put in his mouth. Good luck with that.

This book held my attention from the very beginning. It in a way reminds me of the Saw movies but without as much of the gore. It is interesting to see how the main character Sam Case thinks that he is in charge of the money but ends up losing control of it in the end. I really enjoyed the part from the perspective of Donovan and how he was able to orchestrate the whole elaborate setup. All in all it is a very fun and exciting read.

In Saving Rachel, millionaire Sam Case is taken on a wild ride that shifts and turns faster than his beloved Audi R8 in a high-speed chase. He thinks after such a great morning, the day can only get better. But, by the time the spinning stops an Sam begins to put the puzzle pieces together, there may not be enough time to save her or himself. You will not be able to put this down until you hit the last page!

John Locke's, Saving Rachel (A Donovan Creed Crime Novel) (Kindle edition) reads like an action packed movie.  In fact, I read it so fast I never it put it down for fear of missing out on the plot twists and character surprises that were coming at me like a locomotive.  Think Ocean's Eleven meets Burn Notice and you'll understand the commotion these characters cause and think, "How'd did they do that?"  I highly recommend Saving Rachel and look forward to other John Locke novels.  What an amazing ride!

Saving Rachel proved to be one of the better novels I have read in a very long time.  This book has so many unexpected twists and turns with a number of suprises it is a book I could not put down.  Very well-written it is just the kind of book I like to escape to. I give it 5 stars.

What to do, what to do - Sam Case's world is spinning completely out of control, nothing about it makes sense and Rachel's life hangs in the balance.  John Locke's second crime drama is such a ride you'll need Dramamine, certainly Sam Case could use some.  Perception is everything and Case has lost his bearings.  Just when his life was going so great - reaping big bucks on his latest software program which hides the money of nefarious billionaires from government scrutiny and managing to woo the lovely and seductive Karen Vogel.  Now, it's all falling apart at such a rapid pace that Sam cannot compute much less understand.  But, never fear, the cavalry in the form of Donovan Creed arrives in the nick of time to save the day - or does he?  Another winning novel for John Locke that has no pause button and no snooze alarm.  Buckle your seat belts, including the shoulder strap.

Saving Rachel is about a computer savvy person called Sam Case who is being blackmailed by a bunch of gangsters for money. Sam creates a software that can hide black money from government authorities. He is employed by dangerous gangsters, terrorists, assassins to handle their money; one of them is Donovan Creed. The plot is well written and is presented in two perspectives, one from Sam's point of view and the other from Creed's. The story moves at breathtaking pace and it is hard to stop reading.  Locke has created enough twists and turns in the storyline to maintain the reader's attention.  However, sometimes I felt certain situations were predictable and some twists in the story didn't make much sense. Overall, I think it is a good book and definitely worth a read for mystery lovers.

This was the first time I have had an opportunity to read this author's books and my first impression was "I'm not going to like this." I was so tempted to put this book down because I was bored initially, but that changed real fast. I'm glad I kept reading because it turned out to be a great murder, mystery novel. What I liked the most about this book is the way the author tagged me along with all the unexpected thoughts racing through my head of what's going to happen next.  I look forward to reading more of John Locke's books.  Living a double life can be very hard and challenging at times and Locke laid out the plot in this story really well in this book.

.....this truly is a wild ride!! I pride myself on being able to figure out the upcoming twists and turns with most mystery novels. John Locke has produced such a well written, fun novel that I found myself just sitting back and enjoying the journey..I could never foresee what was going to happen in his creative mind.  I read aloud a section to my husband that was particularly thrilling and he ended up wanting me to read the entire novel to him....this is not even a genre that he normally enjoys!!!

Readers can't help but get engrossed in John Locke's book "Saving Rachel: A Donovan Creed Crime Novel." The writing of this novel allows the reader to feel they are actually there. As they turn each page readers are eager to learn more about the characters and what will happen next. It is such a fantastic read the reader doesn't want to take a break and close it until the story ends even though they are still eager for more.

Saving Rachel was my first John Locke novel and it won't be my last. The energy-charged rush starts with the first page and doesn't stop until the last. I literally read the book from start to finish without putting it down. Locke's characters and non-stop plot twists pull the reader into the story and don't let go until the very end. With Saving Rachel, Locke clearly demonstrates that he is a talented author able to develop a first-rate, engaging and thrilling crime novel that will keep you wondering what's going to happen next. Reading this book was a wild ride that I thoroughly enjoyed. I'm looking forward to reading more by John Locke.

Saving Rachel is a Donovan Creed crime novel, written in the first-person narrative style. The main character throughout Part One of the book is Sam Case, a technology geek who has managed to devise a method for keeping billions of dollars safe for his small and dangerous group of unsavory clientele. He becomes entangled in an affair and his life unwinds at breakneck speed. The main character in Part Two of the book is Donovan Creed, an assassin who works for Homeland Security as well as clients in the private sector. You get to know and like Donovan Creed as he explains the events that have unfolded involving Sam Case, his wife, and his mistress. Saving Rachel is suspenseful and entertaining, with action from start to finish. It is ideal for readers who seek a crime drama full of interesting characters and non-stop action, without too much gore or violence to interrupt the flow of the story.

While reading Saving Rachel, I kept telling myself "okay after this chapter I'm going to put it down for awhile." I couldn't! It kept my interest till the very last word. Donovan Creed  has been in the Locke books before and is a peculiar character who may not see things the way they truly are. This is known because much of the story is told through the eyes of Sam Case, who is quite the rule breaker. He finds himself in a bad place and has to give secret codes to save his wife.  This story is about Greed, Betrayal, and what one will do for love.

I wasn't sure what I was getting myself into when I first purchased "Saving Rachel" by John Locke, but I certainly found out very quickly.  This was the first book I read by Locke and didn't have any expectations, outside of one recommendation from a friend.  The story began to unfold very safely and I felt like I had a pretty good grasp on what was happening in the book and began to empathize with the characters.  But, no sooner had I relaxed into the narrative did I begin to question the very planet this madness was taking place on.  I certainly don't want to give away any of the story, but to borrow from Locke, this book is a real "mindfreak".  It is like driving a car as it begins to transform into a rollercoaster.  You can still see the road, or tracks, directly in front of you; and though you fight it initially you finally settle into the story and let it run its break-neck and exhilarating arc.  This book was really good, if a bit over the top at times.  But even in those times the story doesn't take itself too seriously and it becomes quite humorous.  This book messed up my life, because a one hour pleasure read became an all night page turning adventure.  So, I highly recommend this book for anyone who enjoys adventure, conspiracy, crazy twisting story lines, writing with the thick aroma of sexuality, and a bit of humor as well.

Sam Case, you dug your own hole but I can't help but feel sorry for the poor guy but at the same time, I don't. Poor Sam could not figure out what was happening in his life, he just kept rolling with punches. There were so many twists and turns in this book I was completely hooked from beginning until the end. I felt like I was on a roller coaster ride with Sam. Donovan Creed of course wraps the book up nicely so you get a good finish as well as a great beginning. Definitely worth reading.

Saving Rachel by John Locke is another exciting Donovan Creed Novel.  This is a non-fiction book that is exciting from the first page to the last.  It combines elements of mystery, adventure and even romance.  John Locke uses Donovan Creed to write complex and interesting stories.Although I like the writing style it is disconcerting the way the story keeps changing.  That eventually becomes part of the charm of the book.  The reader is drawn into a puzzling story of greed and corruption. The book also examines the motives behind people.  This is done through the actions of many of the characters in the book.  Each one is in some way responsible for motives that are not readily apparent to the reader.  Their motives look understandable but are way too complex for the surface examination.  The story starts out with a common man named Sam who lives an extraordinary lifestyle.  He is with what is described and a beautiful woman in the very beginning.  We soon find he has a wife who is lovely in an entirely different way.  The wife's name is Rachel. Sam is fortunate to have a skill that he is able to use to give him the money to buy many fine toys.  Unfortunately it is also that skill that gets him into trouble.  There are so many twists and turns to this novel that it is a challenge to keep up.  Whether keeping up with high speed chases or the movements of dead bodies, this book kept me turning the pages.  Although the novel did not start with the character Donovan Creed's involvement, his entrance definitely kicked up the excitement and eventually the understanding. I definitely recommend this book to people who like trying to figure out the story as they read.  If a novel is easily dissected I quickly lose interest.  That is definitely not a problem with this book. The reader is definitely engaged in another original type of book which will be a fun addition to their library.

Sam Case is having a very bad day. Of course, it didn't start out like that. For Sam life is good, that is until he's drugged and thrown into a limousine with some gentlemen who....lets just say aren't exactly the soft type. In "Saving Rachel" you're thrown head first into Sam's ordeal which is filled with action, drama, and even a touch of humor as Sam places all hope in Donovan Creeds hands. "Saving Rachel" proves that sometimes it is better the devil you know, than the devil you don't.

Saving Rachel by John Locke should definitely become a movie. With all of the action and mystery that takes place it is sure to be a blockbuster hit! The characters are well-developed. By the description you get a feel for what each one looks like and each one's personality. The way this story is written is brilliant! The story really talks to the reader and makes the reader "feel" the characters especially when they are frightened. Sam, the character, develops a very unique plan to get rich and everything in his life goes awry. You hope for Sam to get away from the police with all of the action that goes down right from the beginning. Then you hope for the people that are trapped (I won't tell too much) to be chosen to live. You get even more suprises during this time. You are sure to enjoy reading this book and you will not want to put it down, in fact, you will not be ABLE to put it down.

I should have known that this was going to be a very exciting and unexpected read from the minute I began reading.  What I liked about this thriller was that it took off running from the very first second and does not give you a chance to stop.  Saving Rachel is fast paced, full of unexpected turns and points that I didn't catch onto right away like I do with so many other tired plots. It really takes some imagination to come up with the events of this read, so you will definitely not be disappointed. I can't wait to read more from this author, but Saving Rachel is going to be hard to top.

"Saving Rachel" is a mystery written by John Locke.  The story centers around a cheating husband and what ensues is a thrilling ride through plot twists and turns.  You are never quite sure what will happen and just when you think you have got it solved, the story takes another turn.  This is a book that I just could not put down and was thinking about when I wasn't reading it.  Great story line, great characters and a great mystery!

I really enjoy reading mystery books and John Locke created a thrilling story with the book "Saving Rachel". This is the second book in the series and a follow up to the book "Lethal People". The character Donovan Creed was developed in the last book. Now Donovan is making another appearance in this story. Readers will get a chance to learn more about Donovan and how Donovan adds a mysterious twist to the story. Another important character is Sam Case. This story is told through the eyes of Sam. In addition, a lot of the information revealed about Donovan Creed is told through the eyes of Sam Case. As well as, parts of the storyline is narrated through the eyes of Donovan. As the story goes on, you will realize that Donovan will not see things they way they really are. The plots and twists of the story are very exciting. I really enjoyed this book.

"Saving Rachel" by John Locke creates the perfect mystery novel.  While the imagery can be disturbing, its real life.  I was riveted and could not put the book down.  This story of infidelity pushes the limits of what you mind can comprehend and you are not sure until the very end, what will happen.  The plot twists are exhilarating and something any good mystery should strive to be.  If you want to be taken on a fun ride where you really have to think and solve the case, this is the book.

John Locke has made my day with his latest Donovan Creed tale, Saving Rachel. Saving Rachel pushes the envelope of excitement. The seemingly standard cheating husband story quickly turns into a fast paced race to discover who is out to get Sam. You can never be certain of the villains and the saviors. It is not surprising that the good guy/bad guy lines are blurred: after all, this is a Donovan Creed novel. The story is enjoyable because the reader will keep guessing through the twists, and you learn not to assume anything.  Poor Sam has an unbelievably bad day and I loved watching the story unfold.

I loved this book, It did not seem like a very long read to me because I just could not stop turning the pages. I kept on putting myself in the place of Sam, and then Karen, and Rachel and finally in Kevin's (Donovan) shoes. What would I do, who would I save? Would I give away all the money so easily and what would happen to me if I did. What kind of faith would I have after all was said and done. Just a wonderful action packed book, you won't want to put it down until its done and when it finally is done you will wish that it wasn't. A sure must read!
We listened to this story and enjoyed it from the very begining, the character development was supreb.

Saving Rachel seemed like a short book to me because I read it a couple hours.  I was intrigued from the first page and surprised at how many odd twists and turns there were.  I saw a couple of them coming but was really caught off guard by others.  Basically, if you want to read something that has you guessing the whole way through - this is the perfect book for you.  Didn't make me like Donovan Creed any better though.  In John Locke's first book "Lethal People" I liked Creed at times and others times wanted to shoot the jerk, and same for this book as well.  However, even with all of Creed's faults, Locke is an engaging and talented writer who can capture your attention and thoroughly entertain.

Mystery novels really aren't my thing. I have enough stress in my life that adding on the fictional stress of "whodunit" is not fun. But something about this novel caught my eye. The first 30 pages melted under my eyes because I was reading so fast. I had to know what happened next. And that was just the first 30 pages! This book reminds me of the movie "The Game" in that I was always trying to figure out who was who since many of the characters have multiple identities and there is all sorts of double-agent spy stuff happening. But that is part of what I liked about it - I had to think while I read it. If you have the time to spare, then pick up this book. I'm not sure you'll be able to put it down before you read every last page!

I hardly read books because I'm a such a busy working mother, but I couldn't put this one down.  I started reading it and just loved the story.  John Locke does a wonderful job of keeping the mystery going so it's not predictable, but he ties it all together in the end. I recommend giving it a read. You will enjoy the ride.

Get ready for a ride that goes a mile a minute from first page to last, you're never sure where the next sentence is going to take you. and then the ending leaves you craving more. Reminds me of books I used to sneak into my room and read when everyone else was asleep.

Easy read.  Loved all the twists and turns.  Wanted to read what was coming next.  Plus loved the low price.

I only got this book because it was so cheap but I wasn't expecting to stay up all night and finish it. It was very fast pace and had A LOT of twists I didn't see coming. For the price its a must read!

This was an awesome read! I love the way Locke tells a story. He captures you from the very beginning.

When I starting reading the beginning few pages, I didn't felt it will turn out to be one of the best books I ever read, the story line was excellent and the characters sure to make a lasting print in your minds. After long years, I had a feeling of reading a real enthralling and entertaining book. My special appreciation and thanks for the author for taking effort in getting this book to me. It is worth.
Loved this book.  One of my first reads on my new Kindle.  There are many twists and turns that you don't see coming.  It's fun and entertaining.  My husband is reading it now.

Murder, madmen and midgets...affairs, assassins and actors. Saving Rachel is a twisting, turning roller coaster ride of the best kind. John Locke came out with guns blazing on this one! Mr. Locke used every trick in the book plus some new ones and I was mesmerized. I absolutely could not put this book down and even found myself laughing out loud more than a few times. Saving Rachel is the ultimate adventure with kick-in-the-backside action and I would highly recommend it to everyone. Please make it a point that you pick up this 'must read' book soon. You will not be disappointed.

Three words. Buy...this...book. First, for 99¢ what do you have to lose? Second, it's a fantastic tail that keeps you guessing and keeps you reading until 3am...two nights in a row. I am huge fan of the thriller/mystery genre; consequently, I have quite high expectations when it comes to these types of books.  Luckily, this book did not disappoint!  This book is extremely fast-paced - and it is definitely one of those books that captures your complete attention and beckons you to read more and more.  I definitely would recommend this book to other readers.

The latest Donovan Creed Novel by John Locke for the Kindle has a quick fiery opening with a tried and true plot line of sexy subterfuge. And just when you think you have a bead on the plot's direction is takes some chicanes that leave you craving the next chapters. Gangsters, guns, murder, sex, blackmail and even midgets make this ebook a one of a kind fast fun read!

John Locke has done a wonderful job here - entertaining, intriguing, action packed!  This is definitely a good read for a cold blistery day when you can take the time to settle down with a nice cup of hot cider.  There's a lot going on.  The book has two parts.  The descriptive phraseology of part one, along with the references to popular culture such as the Sopranos, Incredible Hulk, Victoria's Secret, bring you into the narrator's very modern mind set and story right away.  It can get a bit tedious but overall it works.  Part two brings with it a lot of twists and turns which keep your attention span up.  In fact, part two brought to mind that this book might work adapted for television audiences as a mini series where each week you can tune in to a continuing episode - yes, there is that much action and interplay between the characters here.  If you want a very subdued murder mystery, this may not be the book for you.  If however, you want to be kept on the edge of your seat with suspense, enjoy being taken for a bumpy ride with modern twists and turns alluding to the present day financial situation and the challenge of deciphering illusions from reality, you will enjoy Saving Rachel.

So when I read the description I wasn't sure what to expect.  This book definitely went beyond my expectations and it was a great thing.  The story contained some comedic moments with many twists and turns. I did not expect the ending at all.  I loved it so much I had to purchase "Now and Then" so I could see what happened next in this exhilarating series.

Saving Rachel is the first novel by John Locke that I have read.  This fast paced novel,with plenty of sex,violence and plot twists, kept my attention from beginning to end. The novel's narrator is  Sam Case. Case is confused,unfaithful and morally challenged.  The more I learned about Sam the less I liked him. It's hard to like a character who has no problem saying he loved his wife ten minutes after leaving Karen Vogel's bed.   Creed,the operative/assassin/hitman who makes no pretense about himself, juggles most of the plot twists.  Honestly, I think there might have been too many plot twists. But, Locke masterfully balances all  the plot twists and revelations so well that it works. Without ruining the ending,I admit that I liked his character and will read some of the other Donovan Creed mystery novels.   I read this book in one evening.  I would recommend it to anyone who likes a fast paced thriller.

The basic plot you can tell from the back cover - there's money, sex, scandal and crime - but what you can't tell from a summary is that this book is a page turner from the get-go. By page two, you're already thrilled with a twist. John Locke has incredible talent, so my recommendation is two-fold: 1. Get the book 2. Buy it on a day that you have the afternoon to sit down and read it, because you want want to stop once you start.

John Locke takes you on a wild ride in "Saving Rachel," with the story of computer whiz Sam Case, wealthy creator of a software that makes funds untraceable to any government branch.  In his line of work he meets some tough characters, including Locke's lethal and loved by readers' assassin,  Donavon Creed.   Sam, genius that he is, can't seem to make things right with his long term wife Rachel.  So he cunningly finds his way into the arms and bed of amazingly gorgeous Karen Vogel. That's when chaos starts to fall from the sky in droplets of  kidnapping, corpses and gun firing mobsters.  Locke throws in some midgets as well.  While some scenes are comical,the weight of the situation is that both his wife and mistress have been kidnapped. It falls down to Sam having to decide which one lives and dies. It's a pretty short read but there's more than enough twists and turns inside these pages to keep you satisfied. Sam is a well developed character and his reactions are purely human. Although he is worried about saving his wife Rachel  and mistress Karen , you'll still see him  trying to find ways  Rachel won't find out about the affair.   The book is well written. Locke balances action, reflective thought and dialogue from the characters. It`s not like your just reading action sequences in a script.  Towards the middle of the story, there is a recap of what was really going on behind the scenes. While some  of it's dull in comparison to overall flow of suspense in the book , it is needed for  the ending to all come together harmoniously .   Thriller and mystery lovers read and enjoy, but just remember to close your mouth while you do!

John Locke does a fantastic job keeping his readers on their toes.  This novel was never slow, rather sometimes a little too fast-paced.  The character development is deep enough for you to draw feeling towards all the characters, whether it be love or hate, and you hope it all turns out for the best.  This book will keep you guessing and shock you over and over.  The description makes you feel as though you are following Sam Case around Kentucky, so much so that you almost feel the need to catch your breath.  I look forward to reading further novels from this author, and would recommend this read to anyone.

"Saving Rachel: A Donovan Creed Crime Novel" is a whirlwind of twists and turns at every corner.  The pace is so fast that the reader needs to really be into the book or risk missing an important plot element.  However, the combination of breakneck speed and dynamic characters meshes seamlessly.  John Locke's research, time, and efforts are transparent in the unfolding of the plot and the depth of each character. The book revolves around the main character, Sam Case.  The opening scene itself is riveting as Sam describes his "conquest" of the stunning Karen Vogel.  This scene presents a disturbing element right from the beginning: Sam is a married man and in love with Rachel, yet he is engaging in an extra-marital relationship with another woman.  The passage that reveals a lot about Sam's character occurs in the beginning: "I know you'll find this hard to believe given my recent activities with Karen Vogel and having heard me profess my love for her back in the hotel room.  You need to understand--well, you don't need to understand it at all.But I'd like to explain.  Wooing and bedding Karen has nothing to do with loving Rachel.  I need--I crave--the attention, the...appreciation."  The main character is certainly flawed don't you think?  Despite the fact that Sam is clearly not the prototypical protagonist, Sam's flaws make him more endearing and real. Once the character of Donovan Creed is revealed, the book spirals out of control, with the plot twisting left and right.  Sam's business is hiding money, and lots of it.  Unfortunately, the people he hides money for are mobsters, etc. Ultimately, I recommend that any thriller aficionado pick this book up and devour it.  It's wickedly good and will leave you catching your breath at every moment.

From the first page this book hooks you.  At times you think you have something straightened out, but then a twist comes in. Once I started reading this book I could not put it down until it was over.  It's a short read but a very good one! This was a great story with many unexpected twists. I found this to be quite an enjoyable book and look forward to all of the Donovan Creed series

"Destined to Live, Despite Me: Biblical Truths for Suicide Survivors" is an incredibly real look into the mind of a suicidal young woman and a testament to the power of faith.  Yolanda Banks, author and suicide survivor, takes us by the hand and shows us what it's like to feel utterly hopeless to the point of taking her own life and how she managed to turn near tragedy into triumph through the power of her faith and God's love. As someone who is close to someone who has attempted suicide and failed, I can appreciate the candid and frank nature that Ms. Banks imparts as she tells her story.  It gives those of us who have watched someone struggle with thoughts of suicide a greater understanding of how tough this struggle really is and how precious one's faith in God can be.

This was a great book!  Ken Follett is a phenomenal story-teller.  The story is woven through the lives of two families and the interaction among the characters is top-notch.  I would highly recommend this book!

I don't care what anyone else says about this book... I THOROUGHLY ENJOYED IT!! I just finished John Locke's "Saving Rachel," and am now ready to download all his other books. I haven't had this much fun reading in a very long time! The slow reveal that takes place chapter by chapter is like eating a box of Godiva chocolates, each bite is better than the one before, and leaves you craving more. John Locke writes some amazing books.  Saving Rachel is the second book in this series.  The protaganist, Donovan Creed, is a killer of terrorists for Homeland Security. Like DeMille's character, John Corey, Creed is a funny quipster who keeps the reader entertained - yes, while he's killing someone. The author has enough references in each book so you don't really need to read them in sequence unless you like keeping the girl friends in order. A funny and outrageous book - you'll love it!

The only thing missing from this book, in my opinion, was a more thorough narration from Creed. I felt like his point of view, while in character, was incredibly fast-paced for proper enjoyment on his perspective. Overall, however, this book was a great read, and I highly recommend it for anyone wishing a quick and fun read.

Saving Rachel (A Donovan Creed Crime Novel) (Kindle edition) by John Locke was my first Creed/Locke book, but it won't be my last. Except for a few pages here and there which I felt went into a little bit more detail than necessary to move the story along, this was an exciting, fast-paced read. And I know it's a cliche to say, but once I started reading, I couldn't stop until the end. Now I'm hooked and can't wait until I get to the next novel in the series. If you like the classic good guy defeats evil story, you're going to be very confused by this novel. The fact is, the only good guys in this novel end up dead, and not all the bad guys get away either. Locke describes a world populated by complex, multi-dimensional characters out to get what they can, but who are still sympathetic enough to care about, or at least synpathetic enough to want to know what happens to them next and how they will fare in the end. If you like to match your wits against the author, this book will keep you on your toes!

Murder mysteries aren't normally my sort of thing.  However, I am a Jesse Stone series fan.  And this novel has something of the same feel to it--not the plot nor the character but the... brutal honesty with which the main characters see themselves and their world.  (They may not always be right but at least they're honest about it.)  Without giving too much away, let me tell you that the plot involves a computer whiz who finds a way to make crooks' money untraceable, an assassin searching for a special someone, an abandoned wife, and nine billion dollars (plus change).  And the novel has more twists and turns than most.  And of course the way the novel speeds along, you never really know what's going on.  Not even at the end, really.  Oh, there are clues that make sense in retrospect but what you (or at least I) wanted to know at the end was whether Rachel was worth it and whether Sam (whom I had come to rather improbably like) was going to live.  I didn't get to find out.  However, as this book is part of a series, I hope I will get an answer in a later novel.  To put it simply: I am hooked.

When I decided to buy this book, I did not expect it to be so much fun.  Saving Rachel is a sometimes disturbing, often amusing, story about a bad man who is forced to make a really bad choice.  The story is told from the point of view of Sam Case, a man whose double life has just been rudely interrupted.  Sam is forced to choose between a wife he is pretty sure he loves, the mistress he might love, and the unusual life he has created for himself.  Saving Rachel is the perfect book for anyone who enjoys action, mystery, and dark humor.

To his friends, Sam Case is a computer whiz.  Even his wife, Rachel, doesn't fully comprehend Lockdown T3, his crowning invention.  One day he finds his world crashing down around him, and barely knows what is real anymore.  All he knows is that the Lockdown program must have something to do with it.  And how is Donovan Creed involved?  You'll have to read the book to find out - but don't worry, the twists and turns will have you caught up and you'll finish the book in no time!

Definitely an excellent read!!  Locke provides extreme on the edge of your seat reading.  Saving Rachel is an action packed book that will leave you on the edge of your seat and will make you not want to put it down.  Locke takes you in several different directions all of them suspenseful and riveting.  You will try to imagine what comes next and then bang-totally different scenario. You choose a path in life that at the time will make you succeed-however; you must live with the consequences that go with it.

Imagine a thriller where everything is not as it seems. Saving Rachel (A Donovan Creed Crime Novel) by John Locke is not your usual linear tale. Instead, this mystery takes you on a wild ride, and you don't know until the very end what has really been going on. Sam Case thought he was having one of the best days of his life until he was thrown into a nightmare where up is down and left is right. Unsure who to trust, what to believe, he embarks on a journey to save those he loves. When he finds himself in a scene that can only be described as freakish and demented, he will have to choose who lives or dies. Or so it seems. Saving Rachel is unlike most narratives in that it has so many plot twists and fun turns. At any moment, the story can turn completely on a dime or on its head. I was eager to find out what was going to be revealed next. This is a page-turner that you won't want to put down. I usually take time to read novels, but read this one all in one sitting. I just had to know! I highly recommend it to anyone who likes the unpredictable crime thriller, who likes novels that continually surprise.

Saving Rachel (A Donovan Creed Crime Novel) [Kindle Edition] grabs you right away and takes you on a thrill ride. Just when you think you know what's going on, something new pops up to burst your bubble. That's what makes it so fascinating and such fun. This was one book that I read all in one sitting, staying up late into the night. It is definitely a page-turner and I just had to know what was going to happen next. Locke's imagery and attention to detail is really enjoyable. At times, I could see this all happening as though I were watching an action thriller. The sly and clever Donovan Creed has found a way to insinuate himself in the middle of a couple's marital woes and an amazing amount of money. Can he pull it off? Will this end well or deadly? These are some of the facets of this intricate mystery. The novelist uses his talent and literary sleight-of-hand to make sure that nothing is predictable. I highly recommend Saving Rachel if you are looking for a mystery/thriller that is unconventional and ultimately satisfying. The characters are well-drawn and very unique. Bravo!

I absolutely loved this book! I could not go to bed until I finished reading this! This is only about the third time in my life that this has happened. Saving Rachel by John Locke is written very well. I love how John Locke writes and speaks to the reader. This story has so many twists and turns. The scary, thrilling, anxiety and hopeful parts of saving a character. I highly recommend this book to anyone who likes well-written stories with drama and suspense. This book is a real thriller!

"Saving Rachel" by John Locke is one in a series of books that falls under the collection "Donovan Creed Crime Novel" series.  Series in novels tend to pop up here and there nowadays.  It's not uncommon to find the newest release on your "to-read" list as the opening to a series set to be drawn out over the coming years.  This fact both thrills and irritates readers alike.  We love reading an author's work when the story fits our mood, but hate the waiting game to know what happens next.  Author John Locke has in fact created a series that while the characters carry on to the next book, each installment reaches a satisfactory "end" to wrap things up....a refreshing idea indeed.  Add to this the great storyline, character set ups, and fast pace of the action....and you simply won't be able to put it down. So whether you are looking for a quick mystery to get you started in the genre, or a small sample of a larger picture, this book will fit the bill.  Read one, read them all....either way your in for a great read.

John Locke's book "Saving Rachel: A Donovan Creed Novel" is hot hot hot. This book starts at page one and doesn't let go. The twists, turns, plots, and shots, are jam packed into this short novel. Never has any book kept me so intrigued all night long until it was done. I started at seven and ended at twelve and never once moved from my seat. GREAT JOB. I cant wait to get my hands on more of John Locke's novels.

Donovan Creed is back for round two of John Locke's books. This time he is not as nice, if you can imagine a hitman being nice to begin with. The story revolves around Sam, and his day from hell. The poor guy at first thinks that the bizarre circumstances he is enduring is due to his affair he recently began, with the letters K and V puzzling him for hours. He later realizes that his affair is a minor issue when in fact someone actually wants him to spill the beans on his top-secret software. He can either give his tormentors the access codes to his clients, which will drain them of their millions of dollars they have saved with Sam's program, or be killed for not budging. Either way will lead to a terrible outcome since he can either deal with some very powerful angry clients, or spend his last day alive being tortured. Luckily he has Creed to help him. Saving Rachel is a wonderful action-packed thriller that will have you wishing the book never ends!

John Locke did not disappoint me once again! I read his first book, Lethal People, and was very impressed. I became hooked and decided to read another one of his masterpieces and let me tell you it was just as great, if not better, than the first! Imagine you had the skills to create a program that would let you transfer tons of money, and I don't mean a few hundred, more like millions, without a trace. This is very appealing to people who are getting their money in shady ways. Your clientele consists of mafia members, hitmen, and terrorists to name a few. Since you are the only one that knows the code to access the software, you probably would not be too surprised if someone would try to pry that information from you. Such is the case with one of the main characters in this book, Sam. One minute he is kidnapped and a witness to multiple murders, the next he is scrambling to find his wife before she becomes the next innocent victim. A perfect action thriller!! I was not disappointed and I am sure you won't be aswell!

This is my first read of the Donovan Creed series and what an introduction to the character it is. I could not put the book down, once I started. It did not take me long to get hooked, basically from page one on I wanted to just get to the end and learn how the characters were connected and why someone would think up this evil game. The book deals with money fraud and attempts to get to the jackpot. This chase involves murder, macabre games involving life and death and a whirlwind of romantic relationships that keep the reader glued to the book. Let's just say, I never predicted the end and each new chapter brought a more surprising plot twist. If it sounds complicated, not really so. Certainly not convoluted, just a nice series of twists and turns, as you would hope from a good thriller that finally manages to keep the reader entertained. This book is written in an easy to read style that is perfect for vacation read. If you like thrillers with unexpected twists and surprise endings, this book is for you. The language and the subject matter is adult, nothing for kids.

Saving Rachel is the second book written by author, John Locke, with Donovan Creed as the main character. I was lucky enough to read the first book, Lethal People, which gave me a good idea of Creed. Imagine a hitman who rakes in millions by working with the mob. In Saving Rachel, the story begins with Sam, a computer genius that created a program that lets his clients move and store millions of dollars without a trace. Majority of people who don't want their money known are terrorists, mobsters, and hitmen, such as Creed. Since Sam is the only person that is aware of the codes that access the software, he becomes a target. It all starts with him being drugged and kidnapped. Fortunately, he is able to escape alive, but his day of horror is far from over. His wife also becomes hostage and he does whatever he can to set her free. With the help of Creed, Sam feels confident that he can save his wife and end the day peacefully, but should he even trust a hitman? Saving Rachel will sink its grip into you and keep you on the edge from beginning until the end. It is a perfect book for fans of action thrillers!!

Saving Rachel by John Locke is a turn-the-page thriller that you can't put down.  It's the third Donovan Reed novel that is full of twists and turns and lots of surprises.  The book tells the story of a corrupt computer genius, Sam Case, who is hiding money for mobsters, terrorists and other lowlifes.  He is forced to choose between the life of his wife, Rachel, and his mistress. Donovan Reed also has used the genius to hide his money.  Now Donovan Reed has to save Sam Case from all the bad buys looking for the money's hiding place. This story is full of mistaken identity, questionable heroes and likeable anti-heroes. Donovan Reed is an odd combination of cool and hard-boiled.  He stays in the shadows for half this story, but so strong is his personality that he still is a strong presence throughout. For anyone who likes mystery thrillers this is a great book and the best so far in this series.

What a pace Saving Rachel sets right from the start! The moment you open the book, off you go! Reading Saving Rachel is like riding in an out of control car up and down hills and valleys. You'll be rolling along enjoying his prose and unique sense of humor and bam, here comes a twist you weren't ready for, and the whole direction of the book changes. When the author comes to the end of a chapter, his ability to come to an abrupt halt is classic. He makes you come to a complete stop and look both ways before continuing.  One of the things I enjoyed so much about Saving Rachel was how one of the main characters, Sam Case, was able to see himself as an unfaithful geek who nonetheless, thought he deserved a high-priced Audi, a 13,000 sq. ft. house even though some of his 18 clients were probably terrorists and thieves, because he designed a brilliant computer system. Unfortunately, one of those clients, Donovan Creed, played ball the hard way. Creating the day Case had in the first part of the story was an imaginative achievement when writing. When Case, Rachel, Karen and Kevin finally get all together, it is a confusing, hilarious image you can visualize. You find out Rachel wasn't who you thought she was, Karen wasn't who you thought she was and Kevin wasn't who you thought he was, but Creed was enjoying all of it. The ensuing confrontations were even more comical as it included thugs, midgets, a lesbian (or was she?) and, worst of all, nobody really knew if they were going to get out of it alive; except maybe Creed. John Locke is a master of surprise, and a complete genius at a designing this genre of crafty plot, and he left you chuckling; totally absorbed in the story all the way to the end.  Saving Rachel is another example of a blockbuster author when he is in caught up in writing the unforgettable series of Donovan Creed stories, and like all the others, it should not be missed. He lets go and slings it at us and we love trying to " get it". Like the speed of the car, it is one fast-paced book. You can't put it down.

Dr. Tim Scully

This is a spiritual journey; a quest.  It's basically about a young man named Siddhartha, of the Brahmin caste, living some time in India about the time of the Buddha.  (By the way, it's important to know that the Siddhartha of this novel is not the same as the historical Buddha, who also shared the same first name.)  Growing up and carefully trained in the religious and philosophical practices of his time, he feels that he needs more and joins an ascetic sect called the Samanas. He learns a lot, but does not achieve what he inwardly desires. He then meets up with "The Buddha" - and although Siddhartha respects him greatly, he cannot accept his teaching.  After a cordial parting with the Buddha, he goes in other directions - and each time he doesn't seem to be able to connect completely with what he desires. Eventually he becomes enlightened after many twists and turns.  Some of it will come as a surprise to the reader, at other times the reader will experience and after-the-fact realization ("Oh, of COURSE!  How could I have missed that?"). I've basically been reading this novel for over 30 years.  I read it for the first time at Muskegon Community College in my 20's and have off and on picked it up and read it again through the years.  In my opinion, regardless of a person's religious (or non-religious) affiliation, this book will ring true for anyone who has ever taken a spiritual journey, even if his or her conclusions are different from Siddhartha's. The most important point made in this book is that each person can and does learn from others' teachings.  But each of us also has our own unique walk and we have to find it for ourselves.  Even if we stay in our own religious or philosophical tradition, our own path is unique and not like everyone else's.
